say:2:1041566801:1.text: Mother, Stitchy and I want to go out and play...
say:2:1041566801:1.source_cn: 妈妈，奇奇说想出去玩，我能一起去吗？

say:3:1041566802:1.text: It's dangerous out... Oh, well, fine. You can go play.
say:3:1041566802:1.source_cn: 外面很危险……好吧，你可以出去玩。

say:4:1041566803:1.text: But you have to put on your coat first.

say:5:1041566804:1.text: I made you a new heavier coat. You said that the embroidery on the last one was a bit too fancy, so this one is more plain.
say:5:1041566804:1.source_cn: 妈妈给你缝了一件厚些的，你说过，上次的绣花有些花哨，所...

say:6:1041566805:1.text: The sleeves seem a little long. Check if it fits you and whether you like the way it looks.
say:6:1041566805:1.source_cn: 袖子好像做长了一些，你先看看合不合身，样子喜不喜欢。

say:7:1041566806:1.text: It looks great, and the sleeves are just right. I'll wear whatever you make.
say:7:1041566806:1.source_cn: 很好看，袖子也刚刚好。无论妈妈做什么我都喜欢。

say:8:1041566807:1.text: But I really like this one. Stitchy likes it too!
say:8:1041566807:1.source_cn: 不过这件我格外喜欢——奇奇也喜欢！

say:9:1041566808:1.text: Then I'll make something for Stitchy too. Should I make a shirt or pants?
say:9:1041566808:1.source_cn: 那下次妈妈也给奇奇做一件吧？要做怎样的，裙子吗？

say:10:1041566809:1.text: Stitchy wants to wear a robe like Father's.
say:10:1041566809:1.source_cn: 不行，奇奇想穿爸爸那样的袍子。

say:11:1041566810:1.text: Oh, that reminds me. I need to make a set of new clothing for Niru.
say:11:1041566810:1.source_cn: 啊，这倒提醒我了，也要给尼汝缝两件新衣服了。

say:12:1041566811:1.text: I think you need a new dress as well. Oh, right! I saw Father prepared a new one for you.
say:12:1041566811:1.source_cn: 妈妈，你也需要一条新裙子——我看到了哦，爸爸偷偷给你准...

say:13:1041566812:1.text: How about we all wear our new clothes and go out next week?
say:13:1041566812:1.source_cn: 过几天，我们一起穿着新衣服出门吧？
